topNews.text: Herculean Effort to Restore Mozambique’s Rhino Population Succeeds with 61 Animals Moved There
topNews.excerpt: 9 female white rhino have been reintroduced to one of Mozambique’s southern national parks as part of a mammoth undertaking to bring back species the country has lost. Mozambique was the victim of one of Africa’s worst post-colonial power struggles, during which time they lost virtually all of several large animals during a civil war
topNews.creator: Andy Corbley
